mentions.name: powerbank.energy
mentions.description: A comprehensive powerbank reference list covering major brands such as Anker, Belkin and Ugreen, showing each model's basic data. The site aims to expand coverage to more brands and add richer comparison attributes such as whether a powerbank is approved for flight and its form factor.
mentions.problem: Powerbank buying research suffers from disorganized, scattered information, which made comparing models difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been researching powerbanks as my current one of 10 years just died. I was dismay at the disarray of information, so I started to build a comprehensive list.
First it is across the major players, Anker, Belkin Ugreen texc. I will expand to others we I come across them. Their basic data is shown, but I want to start collecting data such as "is it approved for flight?" or "its form factor".
mentions.author: yitchelle
